description:
Unregister and delete Beadwork worker tools from the package. Gone for parent and child, not merely hidden.

## Kill list (rip out)

- `beadwork_delegate`
- `beadwork_worker_done`
- `beadwork_land_worker`
- `beadwork_worker_check`

Keep `beadwork_sync` on the parent. Keep start/close/reopen/create/update/comment/label/defer/dependencies on the parent.

## Files

- `packages/pi-beadwork-extension/src/index.ts` — remove those `registerTool` blocks and their execute helpers
- tests that mention these tools

Do **not** delete `orchestrator.ts` here. Stop importing it from `index.ts` if the only callers were these tools. Leave the file on disk until delete-runtime. No lint-ignore, no placeholder export, no deprecated shim.

Published README/migration copy is **4.4**. CLI help/completions are **2.8**. This issue is tool registration only.

## Success criteria

- Those four tools are not registered.
- `beadwork_sync` still registered.

## Test plan

- Unit: registered names exclude the four; include sync, start, close, show.
- Grep: no `registerTool({ name: "beadwork_delegate" })` in src.
- Log: tool name list at registration.

## Considerations

index.ts hotspot. Do not implement `/bw run` or close-issue goal-exit here.

comments.text: Rip out of the package: delegate, worker_done, land_worker, worker_check. Keep beadwork_sync on the parent. This is not a child-hide list.
